description:
Payload for ``message_type='register'``.

An agent's declaration of itself: who it is, and what it can be asked to
do. Sent once per connection — the coordinator's capability registry is
held against the live socket, so a reconnecting agent must register
again or it is connected but undiscoverable.

mode.description: 'ephemeral' keeps the registration in memory only, discarded when the connection ends; 'persistent' also records the agent in the coordinator's database.
mode.title: Mode

capabilities.description: Capability descriptors this agent is offering.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

title: LIP register payload
